hints.title: Frequency of Identical Rows
hints.text: Count black pixels per column and count occurrences of identical row configurations across the grid.

hints.title: Target Condition Verification
hints.text: A candidate row must contain target black pixels and occur exactly target times among all rows to satisfy the identity condition.

hints.title: Pattern Counting Algorithm
hints.text: Store the count of black pixels per column. Aggregate row strings into a dictionary tracking their frequency. For each unique row pattern whose frequency equals target and black pixel count equals target, check each column having a black pixel. If column black count also equals target, add target to total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear scan aggregating rows into string keys.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing pairs of rows pairwise across columns yields O(M^2 * N) time which is redundant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hashing row string configurations aggregates identical rows in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that all rows with black pixels in the column must be completely identical, implying row count equals target.
